SUMMARY.md: A simple NestJS API that delivers country-specific shame messages. Perfect for adding a bit of humor to your applications or motivating your team with culturally-aware shame quotes. Because logs warn you, errors stop you, but shame changes you.
The IP address of the requester (when available)
The country code for which the shame message was generated
The shame message tailored to the specified or detected country
Whether the country was automatically detected from the IP address (true) or explicitly provided via query parameter (false)
